response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong breadth across web, backend, and systems programming, and some genuinely relevant high-throughput distributed systems work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic. However, the role's core minimum qualification — 8 years of C++ — is far from met (roughly 7 months of professional C++ at National Instruments plus a thesis project), and his depth is in DLang, TypeScript, and Node.js rather than cloud compute infrastructure. There is also no formal technical leadership or mentoring-of-teams track record at the scale this role demands, making him a poor fit despite solid general seniority.
strengths: Low-latency distributed systems experience handling millions of HTTP requests/sec (DLang, async I/O, caching)
Broad, adaptable engineering background with strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and open-source projects, suggesting mentoring aptitude
concerns: Falls far short of the 8-year C++ requirement (~7 months professional C++ experience)
No formal technical leadership role leading strategy or cross-team alignment on large infrastructure projects
Career centered on product/full-stack web work rather than cloud compute platforms, storage, or hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: Limited cloud platform leadership track record
